brief.headline: Push for ₹250/KG laminate price — we currently pay ₹385/KG, 54.0% above the best price we pay elsewhere and top of the fair market band.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/KG on laminate, matching the best price we pay to Silk Polypack.
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹385.00/KG today. Silk Polypack gives us the same material at ₹250.00/KG — a 54.0% gap. The market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so ₹250 sits at the top of the fair band — not a squeeze, just fair market.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 60 days to 30 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹5325 in cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Uflex publishes no financials, so we cannot see their revenue, profit or cash position. That means we build our ask purely on our own purchase data and the open market. Our annual spend with them is ₹64788 — small but real business. With no visibility into their books and a 54.0% price gap to our best source, the safe play is to line up a proven second source (Huhtamaki is already a tiny FDC supplier and can scale) and then negotiate firmly on price and terms, using the backup as leverage.

evidence.point: We pay Uflex ₹385.00/KG for laminate, while Silk Polypack delivers the same item at ₹250.00/KG — a gap of 54.0%.
The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate runs ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg — our ask sits right at the market typical.
Closing the gap to ₹250/KG would save us ₹22718 every year.
Uflex gives us 60-day terms; moving to 30 days frees up ₹5325 in cash for us.
Import unit values for BOPET film (the substrate) are around ₹171.60/kg, well below our ₹385 finished-laminate price — room exists in the chain.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — does pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source option (health score D 31/100, revenue ₹222.04 Cr).

risks: Uflex is a listed flexibles giant — they may not need our ₹64788 annual business and could walk if we push hard; qualify Huhtamaki first to have a real fallback.
No public financials means we cannot tell if they are cash-tight or thriving — use the 54.0% gap and the market band as the anchor, not guesses about their health.
The ₹250/KG target matches our best price from Silk Polypack; confirm Silk can scale before the meeting so the benchmark holds up under challenge.
Moving payment terms from 60 to 30 days tightens their cash by the same ₹5325 we gain — if they resist, consider a smaller step (45 days) or tie faster payment to a deeper price cut.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but we need to talk about the ₹385/KG laminate price — we're paying 54.0% more than our best source, and the market typical is ₹250/kg, so let's find a path to that number.
